oracle: Shared product intent. React and Contract are evaluated independently; React pixels are never the Contract baseline.
cellExpansion: states x themes x viewports x arms
globalRequirements: No required node is clipped, zero-sized, overlapped, or outside the safe viewport.
Focus indicators are visible and are not obscured by overlays.
Text and interactive controls satisfy the active Facet theme rather than arm-local constants.
A viewport change across a size-class boundary updates structure without document reload or lost route state.
Reduced-motion and ordinary-motion modes settle to the same semantic and visual end state.

states.acceptance: The empty explanation and create action form one clear primary column; no event-card placeholder remains.
Every event card exposes title, time, place, host, and open action; card grid uses the viewport's declared column count.
Skeletons reserve the populated-card geometry and do not present stale event content.
Going is the unambiguous selected RSVP state; event, guest, and wall regions remain visible in product order.
Maybe is the unambiguous selected RSVP state with the same stable layout as Going.
The scoped error explains the failed region and offers a visible retry without erasing route identity.
The sheet is topmost, contained in the safe viewport, labelled, scrollable when needed, and keeps the trigger visually identifiable.
Label, input, validation/status region, and submitter are aligned as one semantic form and remain usable with the soft keyboard.
The optimistic row is visually pending but fully readable; existing rows do not jump or lose their anchor.
All fields have visible labels and a coherent reading order; the primary submitter is visible without overlapping browser chrome.
The summary and field error are programmatically and visually linked; entered values remain present and focus target is visible.
The menu is anchored to its trigger, fully visible, uses one clear selected/focused row, and does not shift page layout.
The dialog is centred or platform-appropriately placed above a clear scrim, labelled, focus-contained, and exposes balanced confirm/cancel actions.

keyboard: Tab order follows semantic order; Shift-Tab reverses it.
Enter/Space activate buttons; Enter activates links; Escape dismisses the top overlay.
Menus and listboxes support Arrow keys, Home/End, selection, and focus restoration.
focus: Opening an overlay focuses its declared initial target and traps focus.
Every dismissal path restores focus to the trigger or declared eligible fallback.
Route and HMR teardown never focus a detached node or document body.

reducedMotion.policy: retained only when the host classifies it essential
